applies_to: F03 and every later family. F01 and F02 are audited, not redesigned here.
top_control_safe_zone: Back, wordmark, and info may sit near the safe top.
intro_start_zone: The family title begins below the chrome with a deliberate gap. It does not sit against the controls.
content_safe_zone: Primary type, panels, and amounts stay inside the content rail.
environment_breathing_zone: The right side of an environment plate stays open. Content does not cover the curtain, sky, or architecture.
panel_width_policy: If content does not fit, refine type and spacing before widening the panel into the plate.
bottom_centering_policy: The bottom nav is centered in the app canvas. Inner labels stay left-aligned inside rows.
typographic_containment: Interactive text stays compact. Reduce size and tracking before wrapping. An underline fits the text, not the parent.
icon_label_row: Icon, then label, then optional control, on one row. A wrapping label stays in its own column.
money_formatting: User-facing money uses formatMoney and the active currency symbol.
currency_preference: Global display currency. No foreign-exchange conversion.

responsive_rules.tablet: 834x1194. Wider rail, still short of the plate. Larger intro gap.
responsive_rules.desktop: 1440x900. Rail stays editorial. Nav stays a centered dock, not a full-bleed bar.
